sentences.text: With GPS on every boat, why learn dead reckoning?
If your GPS or power quits, your last fix plus a DR from your logged courses and speeds is how you get home.
Keep a written log of course, speed and the times of every change.
Your chartplotter track only records where you went; it isn’t a DR.
And comparing your DR with a GPS fix shows you exactly how much the current is setting you, which helps you plan the rest of the trip.
